description: Fixed question set for judging changes to the chat prompt. Subject 7 = data mining (KDD lectures), subject 6 = distributed systems. Topics were checked to appear in the ingested corpus. `kind`: narrow = one fact, broad = needs several chunks, unanswerable = not in the material (the model must say so), followup = a second turn that depends on the history. `expect_terms` are a weak automatic signal only (any of the alternatives counts); a human reads the answers.

history.content: K-means is a partitional clustering method: it picks K initial centroids, assigns every point to its closest centroid, then recomputes each centroid as the mean of its cluster, repeating until the assignments stop changing. [kdd_lec09_cluster_analyis.pdf, page 12]

questions.question: Can you explain that again in simpler words?
